Type: coffee table with drawers
Use: holding drinks, books and storing remotes; living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted engineered wood, metal knobs
Colors: black, silver
Shape: rectangular top with overhang, two front drawers with round knobs, tapered square legs, open lower shelf, medium visual weight
Feel: practical, tidy, classic
Goes with: white walls, light wood, woven baskets, grey sofas; traditional or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Ameriwood Home Franklin Coffee Table, Black
product.description: Get the table space you need in your living room with the Ameriwood Home Franklin Coffee Table Made of painted MDF and solid wood legs, the black finish gives the Table a modern feel Place remotes and electronics on the table top and keep books, magazines, or extra throws on the lower open shelf. The 2 drawers are perfect for small items and keep your table top free from clutter Finish your space with the entire Franklin collection (sold separately) The Table ships flat to your door and 2 adults are recommended to assemble. The table top can hold 75 lbs. and the lower shelf will hold 20 lbs. The drawers can hold up to 15 lbs. each. Assembled dimensions: 18.5”H x 41.14”W x 20.6”D
